children: Following the announcement regarding the auction by the UK Debt Management Office, please see details of affected indices and effective dates below:
FTSE Actuaries UK Conventional Gilts up to 5 years Index
4 5/8% Treasury Gilt 2030 (BWBR1P5, GB00BWBR1P52) will be added to the index with a nominal amount of £5000m.
FTSE Actuaries UK Conventional Gilts All Stocks Index
4 5/8% Treasury Gilt 2030 will be added to the index as detailed above.
FTSE Actuaries UK Conventional Gilts up to 15 years Index
4 5/8% Treasury Gilt 2030 will be added to the index as detailed above.
FTSE Actuaries UK Conventional Gilts up to 20 years Index
4 5/8% Treasury Gilt 2030 will be added to the index as detailed above.
FTSE Actuaries UK Conventional Gilts up to 10 years Index
4 5/8% Treasury Gilt 2030 will be added to the index as detailed above.
